purpose: Qualification-only enforced table immutability for exact diagnostic hash reuse; never a default battle optimization

api.parse: parse(primitiveJsonText,{name}) creates and wraps private raw JSON without exposing it
api.wrap: wrap(rawRoot,{name}) transfers exclusive source-facing ownership from trusted host loader
api.immutableMetadata: Only private registered proxies yield frozen {table,path,sha256,kind}; other values yield null
api.assertClean: Throws permanently after any rejected mutation or validation violation, including source-caught errors
api.stats: Counts named roots, validated nodes, lazy proxies, gets, descriptors, writes and failures

hash.algorithm: injected lowercase SHA-256 over canonical JSON encoding of complete cold descriptor graph
coverage: all own keys in source order
raw binary64 sign and payload bits
hash.canonicalPath: First depth-first source own-key path; independent of lazy proxy access order

accepted: extensible ordinary Array.prototype arrays including holes
null, string, boolean and binary64 numbers
shared children within one named root
rejected: all set, defineProperty, deleteProperty, setPrototypeOf and preventExtensions attempts
nonstandard prototypes and native exotic objects
initial proxies when host detection is supplied
integrationRequirements: Use parse or a trusted loader closure that has never exposed raw roots/children to game code and never mutates them afterward
Pure JavaScript cannot detect every initial Proxy or revoke a preexisting raw host alias; direct wrap requires this ownership precondition. parse is the stronger boundary
Keep membrane manager, raw decoded table container, validation records and digest capability outside game globals/window and never return raw targets
Wrap children in both get and getOwnPropertyDescriptor paths; clone operations receive proxies and produce independent mutable copies
Invoke assertClean at every trace event and final completion so source-caught write errors cannot qualify
Any table write or unsupported shape invalidates qualification; fall back to complete dense capture/original table execution rather than ignore a mutation
Registry-based immutable graph leaves may only accept metadata returned by this private membrane, never caller-claimed arbitrary objects
No runtime default integration is enabled by this contract
